text:
maria: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we still have a recurring pattern: some frontends drop trace headers -> missing spans; ETL batch job occasionally replays and causes aggregation dupes -> bad rollups; and we see periodic lag when the checkpoint files are GC'd. We need clear owners, minimal timelines, and a short backfill plan for affected metrics.
jeremy: I can own the frontend span tagging fix. ETA: 3 working days to ship a hotfix + 1 day canary in prod. Will open a PR tomorrow morning.
alex: I'll take the ETL checkpointing and backfill. Plan: add durable checkpoints, stop-gap metric dedupe, then run a targeted backfill for the 6h window last week. Need a small window for the backfill (low traffic).
lina: I'll take aggregation dedupe logic. Suspect double-counts come from partial-retry path in the reducer. I'll add idempotency keys and a unit test harness. ETA: 5 business days.
oncall-bot: Deployed incident postmortem doc: https://confluence.redwood.example/pm/199731 — reminders set for owners.
maria: Thanks — can each owner post a 1-sentence rollout plan + an explicit rollback? also add blockers (infra/time).
jeremy: Rollout plan: add header enforcement and fallback sampling flag; ship behind a feature flag; rollout 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 4 hours. Rollback: flip flag off. Blocker: need confirmation from mobile SDK owners about header propagation.
alex: Backfill plan (high level): 1) stop downstream writes to rollup queue for affected window, 2) run dedupe query + recompute aggregates to staging, 3) validate against live metrics, 4) swap tables. Estimated run time 45m for the 6h window. Rollback: restore table snapshot; Blocker: need short maintenance window and DB replica slot.
lina: Rollout plan: deploy idempotency key to reducer with feature flag, start with test cluster, run smoke. Rollback: revert reducer image. Blocker: need updated sdk that surfaces request ids (jeremy collaboration).
sasha: tagging for oncall ops: I'll reserve the DB maintenance window tomorrow 02:00-04:00 UTC. Leaving buffer on both sides.
maria: alex — can you paste the core backfill SQL you plan to run (small snippet) so infra can review permissions?
alex: Sure, sample snippet below — conservative, uses staging table and dedupe by request_id and timestamp:
```sql
-- backfill dedupe example
INSERT INTO metrics_rollup_staging (metric_name, window_start, value)
SELECT metric_name, window_start, SUM(value) as value
FROM (
  SELECT metric_name, window_start, value, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY request_id, metric_name, window_start ORDER BY incoming_ts DESC) as rn
  FROM metrics_events
  WHERE incoming_ts BETWEEN '2026-03-15T02:00:00Z' AND '2026-03-15T08:00:00Z'
) t
WHERE rn = 1
GROUP BY metric_name, window_start;
```
maria: perfect. jeremy — can you ping mobile SDK owners in #devex and confirm header propagation is solved or blocked?
jeremy: pinged @devex-team in that channel and cc'ed @mobile-leads. Thx.
oncall-bot: Reminder set: 1997312345-owners-checkin scheduled 2026-03-16T09:00:00Z.
maria: Quick success criteria: missing spans <0.05% of traces after rollout; ETL lag < 90s sustained; rollup diffs <0.5% post-backfill. If anyone thinks these are unrealistic, flag now.
lina: fine with metrics. will add unit tests and a small eval prompt to the CI that asserts no duplicates for synthetic traffic.
alex: I'll post a runbook for the backfill with steps, validation queries and a dry-run mode.
maria: Great. I'll consolidate actions into the postmortem doc and assign deadlines: jeremy by EOD+3, alex backfill runbook + infra signoff by EOD+2, lina tests + PR by EOD+5. If anything slips, update the thread. :thumbsup:
jeremy: ack.
alex: ack.
lina: ack.
sasha: DB window confirmed, infra on standby.
maria: Closing loop — we'll re-check here after the canaries/reporting results. Thanks all.
